item.title: Enable Workspace Gateway
item.description: This section describes how to enable a workspace gateway. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Gateway extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a workspace and have the Workspace Gateway Management permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Workspace Gateway Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Disable Workspace Gateway
item.description: This section describes how to disable a workspace gateway. Warning After the gateway is disabled, clients will be unable to access services reverse-proxied by the gateway, which may interrupt related business operations. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Gateway extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a workspace and have the Workspace Gateway Management permission in the workspace.
